description: Use this when the user has risk-of-bias judgements per study and wants the traffic-light plot and the weighted or unweighted summary bar chart (robvis style) for RoB 2, RoB 1, ROBINS-I, ROBINS-I V2, ROBINS-E, QUADAS-2, PROBAST, Newcastle-Ottawa (also its cross-sectional adaptation), JBI or a custom set of domains. Takes the judgements as a list of studies or as a pasted table (robvis layout: Study, D1…Dn, Overall, Weight), returns the figure as SVG and PDF plus the percentage of studies at each level per domain. It does not assess bias itself and never reads papers: every judgement must come from the user. Up to 500 studies. No account needed.

custom.description: Only with instrument 'custom': your own domain names.

scheme.description: three: low/some concerns/high; four: low/moderate/serious/critical; checklist: yes/unclear/no/NA.

headers.description: D1…Dn with a key, or domain names.

studies.description: One entry per study (max 500). Give this or table.

judgements.description: D1…Dn (or domain key) → level, e.g. {D1: 'Low', D2: 'Some concerns'}.

overall.description: Left out: derived by the instrument's rule.

table.description: Pasted robvis table (Study, D1…Dn, Overall[, Weight]); tab, comma or semicolon. Give this or studies.

weighted.description: Weight summary bars by study weight.

name: revisia_risk_of_bias_figure

watermark.description: True when the figure or document carries the revisia mark (no verified account).

title: Risk-of-bias figure
